results.title: Workshop to Evaluate Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools
results.description: The General Authority for Roads and Bridges organized a workshop today to evaluate the use of artificial intelligence tools in the Authority's operations and ways to develop them. Forty-three of the Authority's leaders and staff participated.

results.title: Congress workers protest demanding Amit Shah’s resignation, compensation for NEET students’ families and probe into paper leak
results.description: Congress workers protest in Kalaburagi, demanding Amit Shah's resignation and accountability for NEET-related issues and paper leak inquiries.

results.title: San Diego Renters Force Housing Commission Retreat In Section 8 Rent-Hike Fight
results.description: Two settlements force SDHC to release data on rent increases and bring Section 8 rent-approval policies into compliance with California law.
